checked_sources: Independent commutator resolvent and determinant calculation
correctness.rationale: Independent full-spectrum derivation: let K=−i[H,·], z=λ+γ, and ω=nJ. The two cross-block spaces for the uniform-vector projector P and I−P give eigenvalues ±iω, each n−1 times; the two diagonal blocks give zero n²−2n+2 times. The dephasing is −γI plus γ times the projection to the site diagonal. Compress (zI−K)^{-1} to that diagonal: its constant direction has resolvent 1/z, and any traceless diagonal direction puts squared norm fractions 1/n in each cross-block (PDP=0 and ||PD||²_F=||D||²_F/n). Polarization gives the scalar compression (1−2/n)/z+(2/n)z/(z²+ω²) on the traceless diagonal. The finite-rank determinant lemma now gives λ(λ+γ)^((n−1)(n−2)) times the stated cubic to the power n−1, by rational identity and polynomial continuation. Its constant term is positive, zero is simple, and the cubic is stable by Hurwitz. A negative real cubic root −r exists for every γ>0; regarding its equation as quadratic in γ gives discriminant 4nJ²[nJ²−(n−2)r²]. Since g≤r, equality with the bound forces the repeated solution γ=(n−1)r. At that γ the factor λ+r has r=J√(n/(n−2)), the other two cubic roots have real part −(n−3/2)r and negative quadratic discriminant, and −γ also decays faster for every n≥3. This checks global attainment and uniqueness without a dominant-root assumption away from the optimum. The supplied spot-check code and recorded evidence were read, not executed.
residual_risks: The check is for spectral relaxation on the full matrix space, not finite-time mixing or the excluded n=2 case. The tolerance in the recorded numerical off-optimum tests is not strict-equality exclusion; uniqueness is established algebraically.

Credit the indexed hub-return result for this reduction at J=1, and Bressanini et al. for studying the same open-system model. value.rationale: The complete graph is a natural test case for separating dephasing-induced relaxation from strong-dephasing slowdown. The exact spectrum with multiplicities permits direct benchmarks in every size, and the exact optimizer and maximum give a non-asymptotic target rather than a finite-time proxy or a scaling guess. No new value is assigned to recovering the previously known launch cubic alone.
residual_risks: No implication asserted for finite-time distance metrics, graph-search objectives, or inhomogeneous or non-Markovian noise.
